Now, again the paper is folded, which will divide the paper into four equal symmetrical squares when you unfold the paper. , 

Thus if you see in the third figure, the representation of the first square is given, which contains a particular pattern at the three ends but at the centre there is no pattern and each square has three circles aligned in a particular fashion,

thus all squares will have the same pattern.

As mentioned above all the given points hold true for only figure given in option2) 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
